title: Intermediate Inside clause for module extension by zero stalk maps
statement: For a ringed space X, open W and x in W, there is a natural O_X,x-linear isomorphism from the stalk at x of G on W (with scalars restricted along the inverse restriction-stalk ring isomorphism) to the stalk of its sheafified extension by zero. It sends every germ of a section over V in W to the germ of its image under the unit of the chosen extension/restriction adjunction, over the image of V in X.

proof.text: Take the natural linear morphism t and its germ formula from the unit-induced stalk-morphism lemma.

For each G, forget t to abelian groups. By stalk_hom_ext and restrictStalkIso_hom_eq_germ this additive map equals the stalk map of the unit after the slice equivalence, followed by the restriction-stalk isomorphism. The germ formula for t supplies the equality on each section.

The unit is an isomorphism by the open-extension unit lemma. The slice equivalence, sheaf forgetful functor and additive stalk functor preserve isomorphisms, so the additive map underlying each component of t is an isomorphism. The module forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Package t as a natural isomorphism by NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app and asIso; its germ formula is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Sheaves Tag 00A7 (lemma-j-shriek-modules), clauses (2)-(4); J3 reduction through the unit-induced linear map and invertibility of the chosen unit

mathlib_searches.query: The stalk of sheafification of a presheaf of modules is unchanged and extension by zero has zero stalk outside the open subset

For a sheaf of modules on an open subset, extension by zero has zero stalks outside the open and the unit is an isomorphism on stalks inside; transitions between nested opens are compatible with counits

theorem moduleExtensionByZero_stalk_inside (X : RingedSpace.{u}) :
    (∀ (W : Opens X) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W),
      ∃ e : (W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor ⋙
          RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (X.restrict (Opens.isOpenEmbedding W)) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars
            (X.toPresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso (Opens.isOpenEmbedding W) ⟨x, hx⟩).inv.hom ≅
        (SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)) ⋙
          RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x,
        ∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X).over W)) (V : Opens W)
          (hV : (⟨x, hx⟩ : W) ∈ V)
          (s : ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj G).val.obj (op V)),
          (e.hom.app G) (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u})
              (X := (X.restrict (Opens.isOpenEmbedding W)).carrier)
              ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj G).val.presheaf
              V ⟨x, hx⟩ hV s) =
            TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u}) (X := X.carrier)
              ((SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
                PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)).obj
                  G).val.presheaf
              ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding W).isOpenMap.functor.obj V) x ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hV, rfl⟩
              (((Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X W).2.2.2.2).unit.app
                G).val.app
                (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (Set.image_subset_iff.2 (fun y _ => y.2))))) s))
